scope: Diagnostic labels only. Existing stored body poses/known finite surfaces and verified camera mount yield an unoccluded frustum upper bound. Does NOT replace missing measurements, emulate self-occlusion or prove current plane fitting would succeed. Down camera is a hypothesis using an existing code-defined mount that is disabled in this study. No runtime/camera/controller changes, no rendering/physics/PPO/holdout.

mount_check.body_and_camera_quaternion_order: XYZW; raw camera transform is OpenGL, optical ray frame is ROS

old_pixel_plane_check.scope: Only pixels within10mm of the independently predicted seat plane are counted; this does not verify all occlusions or prove exact rendered-depth reconstruction.
